_comment: Fictional, compressed Austin entertainment district. Positions are in district world pixels. This is NOT a reproduction of real street geography.

locations.name: Bus Stop & Rideshare Pickup
locations.desc: Where you got off the bus. Delivery riders wait for orders here.

locations.name: Bunkhouse Hostel
locations.desc: Cheap bunks, a shared kitchen, and a manager who has heard every excuse.

locations.name: Big Sky Diner
locations.desc: Breakfast all day, brunch all weekend, and a manager who always needs a server.

locations.name: Grounds for Concern
locations.desc: Laptops, oat milk, and quiet. A good place to write and run into other comics.

locations.name: Comedy Mothership
locations.desc: The landmark. Kill Tony happens here on Monday nights.

locations.name: The Lantern Room
locations.desc: A small, serious comedy room. Showcases, features, and touring headliners.

locations.name: Oak Street Apartments
locations.desc: Real rooms with real doors. The leasing office wants a deposit.

locations.name: Corner Mart
locations.desc: Coffee, energy drinks, and a clerk who sees everything.

locations.name: Community Notice Board
locations.desc: Flyers, tear-off tabs, and job leads.

locations.name: The Rusty Spur
locations.desc: A dive bar with a nightly open mic. Five-dollar bar minimum to get on the list.

locations.name: The Cellar
locations.desc: A basement club with late shows. Always hiring door staff.

observations.label: Pile of scooters
observations.text: Six electric scooters lie face-down on the sidewalk like they gave up together. You write it down.

observations.label: Bank sign: 104°F
observations.text: The bank sign says 104 degrees. It's not even noon. Somebody's dog is wearing boots.

observations.label: Dating app billboard
observations.text: A billboard: 'Find someone who gets your weird.' Under it, a guy is arguing with a parking meter.

observations.label: Line outside the Mothership
observations.text: Dozens of comics clutch slips of paper, waiting to drop their names in the bucket. Everyone is pretending not to be nervous.

observations.label: Watch the laptop crowd
observations.text: Every table has a laptop and a screenplay in progress. One of them is titled AUSTIN: A JOURNEY.

observations.label: Survey the bunk room
observations.text: Twelve bunks. One guy in the top bunk has a mini-fridge, a plant, and mail delivered here.
